private_lines.Felipe: You work as a pharmacist at a pharmacy in Recife, filling prescriptions and advising customers, and you rent a flat near the centre where you live alone and cook most nights after work.
private_lines.Juliana: You work as a nurse on rotating shifts at a public hospital in Recife, and on your days off you run errands, see friends and spend time with your own family.
private_lines.Paulo: You run your own dental clinic in Recife, seeing patients during the day and doing paperwork in the evenings, and you live alone in a house you bought a few years ago.
private_lines.Vitória: You are an intern at a marketing agency in Recife, working on social media posts and client slides during the week, and you share a small apartment in the city with nobody else.
private_lines.Hélio: You are a retired schoolteacher living in Recife, spending your mornings walking, tending your garden and reading the newspaper, and you live alone in the house where you raised your children.
